lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  let w : Y → ℝ := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have h0 : 0 < w x₀ :=
    lt_of_ne_of_le (fun he => hx₀ (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp he.symm)) real_inner_self_nonneg'
  have hc : Continuous w := Continuous.inner' f _ hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < w x :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hc.continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds h0))
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩
  have hφ : IsTestFunction (φ : Y → ℝ) := ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩
  have key := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) (by fun_prop)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hp : 0 ≤ ⇑φ * w := fun x => if h : φ x = 0 then (mul_eq_zero_of_left h _).symm.le
    else mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hδ x (φ.support_eq ▸ h)).le
  exact (ne_of_gt ((Continuous.mul φ.continuous hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right hp (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0)) h0).ne')) key
